note: The four equipment manuals used by the AI Tech Magic operator-assistant demo. They were written by AI Tech Magic for demo purposes, for a manufacturer that does not exist, Brennvik Industrial Equipment. The PDFs are not committed here; the demo serves them at demo_url without a password. pdf_pages counts PDF page positions including the cover; the printed page number equals the PDF position on all four. sha256 and bytes are of the PDF file the demo serves from commit 30c1b5f onward, which includes the 2026-11-02 run. earlier_files lists the files used by the 2026-10-21 run at demo commit e249db4; they differ from the current files only in notice wording and the demo address label, with the same pages and values.
